name: Ombel Packaging Records for WooCommerce
author: ombel

sections.description:
Ombel records the packaging used for new WooCommerce orders. Create
packaging profiles with component weights, assign them to products and
variations, include shipping packaging, and review your local records.

The bundled local features remain free, with no expiry or account requirement:

  • Packaging profiles, component weights and version history.
  • Product and variation assignment, bulk assignment and CSV import/export.
  • Order packaging snapshots, local ledger and material totals.
  • Missing-data review, registration records and an audit log.
  • Local preparation views for manual review and export of your own CSV data.
  • Diagnostics that exclude credentials, customer details and raw payloads.

Local recording works without a cloud service and does not block checkout.
Historical orders are not automatically backfilled. A monetary refund does
not automatically deduct packaging mass. Multisite is outside this release’s
scope.

This is a packaging records and preparation tool. It does not certify legal
compliance, determine your obligations, verify official registrations, create
official filing exports or submit declarations. Country guidance and rule
content require your own review. Store records may exclude other sales
channels or producer-wide quantities. Keep your registration and filing process.

External services and privacy

This version runs locally without an external service, account or subscription.
Packaging data stays on your WordPress site. No cloud connection or paid
checkout is offered in this version.

The plugin stores packaging materials and weights, destination countries,
local order identifiers and pseudonymous order references. It does not copy
customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses or payment
details into its packaging records. Avoid personal information in profile
names and business notes. References are pseudonymous, not anonymous: your
store can associate them with its WooCommerce orders.

No automatic retention expiry or personal-data exporter/eraser is implemented.
Review the retention and erasure requirements that apply to your store.
Deactivation and normal plugin deletion preserve packaging records. Intentional
full deletion requires BRIGHTFERN_PPWR_ALLOW_DATA_WIPE developer configuration;
back up your data before using it.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce. Use WordPress 6.4+, WooCommerce 8.0+ and
    PHP 8.1+. Back up your site and database.
  2. Install this plugin and activate it.
  3. Open PPWR & EPR > Setup and enter the business facts you know. Unknown
    information may remain unanswered.
  4. Create a packaging profile with a positive component weight in grams,
    assign it to a product or variation, and configure shipping packaging.
  5. Process a controlled new order and review Overview and Missing data.
sections.faq:
Is this a time-limited trial?

No. The bundled local recording and preparation features remain free.

Does it file official declarations?

No. Review your obligations and complete official reporting manually.
Official filing exports stay unavailable.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce order APIs with HPOS and legacy order storage.

How do I get support?

Contact info@brightfernlabs.com with plugin/WP/Woo/PHP versions, the affected
page, action, time and a reviewed Diagnostics report. Exclude customer details,
passwords, cookies, session tokens and official portal credentials.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fix variation saves, removing packaging assignments and editing draft materials.
  • Preserve packaging records across retries, delayed jobs and deactivation.
  • Fix CSV round trips, bulk variation batches and duplicate batch progress.
  • Improve input validation, incomplete-data reporting and intentional data removal.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org submission candidate with permanent local packaging
    recording and preparation.
  • Official filing exports remain unavailable.
